name: Local-First Operational Store
description: Telemetry is stored locally first (DuckDB). Export is asynchronous. Local store provides immediate operational visibility.
purpose: Operations do not depend on external services.
acceptanceCriteria: DuckDB schema for telemetry storage defined
Telemetry written locally before any export attempt
Local store queryable for operational dashboards
Export runs asynchronously with failure tolerance
Store eviction policy prevents unbounded growth
